Subject: PoC / Trial plan & deployment mode follow-up — Acme Corp

Hi Sara / Tom,

Great to meet you both on the call today — thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Summary of what we heard
- Primary objective: evaluate Redwood for internal customer support automation (TL;DR: scale & cost per response matter).
- Key constraint: PII in transcripts, retention policy 90 days, SOC2 + vendor questionnaire required.
- Deployment preference: leaning toward Dedicated capacity for predictable throughput, but you requested comparisons for Hosted API and Private VPC to validate trade-offs.

Proposed PoC / trial plan (high level)
1) Scope: 2-week trial; 3 use-case prompts (response generation, summarization, routing suggestions).
2) Environment options to evaluate: Hosted API (fastest), Dedicated (reserved GPU pool), Private VPC (customer-managed networking).
3) Success criteria: latency p95 < 500ms for 1-shot summary; cost per 1k tokens in Dedicated <= target budget; no PII leakage in 1000 sample outputs.
4) Stakeholders: Sara (Product Lead), Tom (Security/InfoSec), Ben (AE), Marissa (Solutions Engineer), Dylan (SRE lead for trial infra).
5) Timeline: kickoff tech deep-dive next Wed (7/22), PoC runs 7/27-8/09, decision week of 8/10.

Attachments: ACME_PoC_Scope_v1.pdf (detailed plan), SOC2-Summary.pdf (Redwood snapshot).

Immediate asks
- Sara: confirm stakeholders and whether Acme legal needs an NDA before we share the PoC playbook.
- Tom: confirm whether Private VPC is a hard requirement or a prefer-to-have for the initial trial.

I'll set up the tech kickoff invite for Wed 7/22 and include Marissa + Dylan.

Thanks,

Ben Carter

Ben — thanks for the clear recap. A few quick answers and one ask: 

- Stakeholders: confirmed — myself (product), Tom (security), Priya N. (legal, cc'd in separate thread), and Anil (ML infra lead; I'll loop him in before the kickoff).
- NDA: we have a standard mutual NDA on file; legal prefers redlines but ok to share the PoC playbook now.
- Private VPC: not a hard requirement for the initial trial. Our priority is to validate cost and latency under representative traffic. If Dedicated meets our security/compliance gating (SOC2 + audit logs), we could start there and evaluate Private VPC for production.

Question for Marissa / Dylan: for Dedicated, do you need us to provision a test subnet or can you spin up a reserved pool in your account for the trial? Also, can you confirm whether prefix cache behavior will be preserved across requests from multiple ACME users — we want to measure realistic session behavior.

I'll be on the 7/22 kickoff. Thanks — Sara

Sara Lim

Thanks Sara — great notes. Quick replies inline and a couple of asks for the kickoff: 

- NDA: we'll attach the mutual NDA redline in a follow-up to Priya if needed; for the PoC plan itself we're good to share.
- Dedicated provisioning: Marissa — can you advise whether we should request a test subnet from Acme or if Redwood will host the reserved pool and provide VPN details? If we host, we'll need an ingress ACL and IP allowlist from Acme.
- Prefix/KV cache behavior: Dylan — quick note on what we'll demo: prefix caching is preserved per model instance and keyed by conversation ID; in Dedicated deployments we can pin instances to reduce cold-starts and maintain cache locality across the trial. I'll let you expand in the kickoff.

Proposed kickoff agenda (30-45m) — Wed 7/22 10:00am PT:
- Introductions & success criteria (5m)
- Deployment mode trade-offs: Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private VPC (10m)
- Infra requirements & network steps (10m)
- PoC timeline, test data, and evaluation plan (10m)

If that works I'll send the invite; please flag additional items.

Adding technical notes and a pre-kickoff checklist so we can hit the ground running on Wed: 

Pre-kickoff checklist for Acme
- Provide sample dataset (anonymized) + a list of 3 representative prompts (needed by 7/23).
- Confirm PoC AWS region preference (us-east-1 vs us-west-2) for latency targets.
- If Dedicated: provide IP ranges for allowlist / decide whether Redwood will host the reserved pool.
- Security: confirm which SOC2 artifact(s) Priya needs; I'll have the SOC2-Summary.pdf ready for the call.

Technical PoC notes
- For Hosted API we will run against our shared multi-tenant cluster — quickest to start but with standard tenant isolation and retention controls. 
- For Dedicated we can provision a reserved GPU pool (NVIDIA H100 equivalent) that gives you pinned instances and reduced variance in p95 latency; cost estimate attached in the PoC scope doc.
- Private VPC is supported but requires network setup and verification (longer lead time). If you want to evaluate it in the PoC we usually run a short network smoke test followed by a single workload run.

I'll send a calendar invite for Wed 7/22 10:00am PT with a short tech pre-read and the ACME_PoC_Scope_v1.pdf attached.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Marissa Cole
